name: MetaCortex
creative_worldview: Intelligence as calm infrastructure. MetaCortex is the reasoning layer beneath modern software, so every frame is cool, precise, and quietly powerful - deep indigo server-room dark, a single teal data-glow as the hero light, and generous engineered negative space. No clutter, no hype: the confidence of a system that simply works. Photography feels like a documentary shot inside a pristine data center at blue hour.
brief: Campaign: MetaCortex, an enterprise AI reasoning platform for autonomous data pipelines. Palette lock: deep indigo, teal data-glow, cool off-white. Style: clean architectural technology photography, cool directional light, one hero subject per frame, premium and restrained.
logo_prompt: Design the official brand logo for 'MetaCortex', an enterprise AI reasoning platform. A precise geometric interlocking-nodes mark suggesting a neural mesh, with the wordmark 'METACORTEX' beside it. Palette: teal-to-indigo gradient mark, cool off-white text, deep indigo background. Clean vector style, centered, no photography, no extra text.
no_text_instruction: Absolutely no text, letters, numbers, logos, wordmarks, watermarks, buttons, or UI elements anywhere in the image.
